reason: Mitra sounds useful, especially a weekly plan in Hindi from my own numbers, but the affiliate links and paid deals worry me. My audience follows me because I feel like one of them, and I don't want them to think I'm selling to them. I'd use the free start first and only think about paying once I've seen the weekly ideas actually work on my channel.
objection: If I start putting affiliate links and local shop deals in my videos, my audience may trust me less, and I'd lose the thing that keeps my channel growing.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing that the weekly ideas beat my usual views on my own channel, and that Mitra only ever shows a deal I can say no to, with the fee visible before I accept.
